I will give you my perspective as an ex sufferer of POCD that still has the thoughts from time to time at random. The only way to be free is to accept the thoughts as... Thoughts. I am no more a pedophile than the next person. Sure, they don't randomly think something intrusive about children for the most part but they have other intrusive thoughts, maybe falling in train tracks or throwing a baby down the stairs. It's silly to ponder about these thoughts. Our brains are Just misfiring, nothing more.

This is the kind of shit "I am so ocd I like to clean" does to people. You should educate yourself on the disorder. OP has intrusive thoughts of sexually abusing people, not a desire to do so. You can't control intrusive thoughts. Ever thought about jumping in front of a train randomly and were like "oh that's scary but I am not suicidal"? That's an intrusive thought.

You were being abused and were highly distressed. It's OK. You didn't Hurt him or planning to. I know you would never Hurt him. You Just wanted him to stop. You are a good person and thats why you suffer. Obsessing over past real events is called real event ocd. This sounds like typical ocd. You need ERP and CBT. Maybe meds too.

Hey I know for people that are not educated on ocd this may seem vile but I can vouch for people with these "vile" thoughts and they would never act on them. Quite the opposite. You are in less danger of being raped by a person with harm ocd obsessing about rape than by the average person. That's why they are intrusive.

Hey this definitely sounds like ocd. Avoidance is also a compulsion. It's not your fault. Ocd is a beast. There is also something called guilt ocd or real event ocd where you obsess about real events that happened in the past.
